# Punch-in zoom style

**How do we zoom for emphasis on a talking shot?** · [all approaches](index.md)


## No punch-ins
<a id="none"></a>

The framing never changes within a shot.

**Looks like:** One steady frame per shot; emphasis comes from voice and text only.

**Good at:** calm; speed; no crop quality loss

**Weak at:** static; fewer pattern interrupts

**Best for:** formats reel30, story, podcast · niches all · goals speed · effort low

**How:** Nothing to add.

**Backed by:** [Podcast body: long takes, demos as interrupts](../topics/editing.md#edit-podcast-long-takes), [Subtle 105–110% punch-in on key phrases](../topics/effects.md#fx-subtle-punch-in), [Axial jump cuts every 3–6 words](../topics/editing.md#edit-axial-jump-cuts), [Bigger 1.15–1.3× punch-ins on punchlines](../topics/effects.md#fx-big-punch-in), [Whip pan over recursive zoom](../topics/transitions.md#l10-whip-not-recursive-zoom) · sources L08

## Subtle 105–110%
<a id="subtle"></a>

A small punch-in on key phrases and at each new section.

**Looks like:** When a new point starts, the frame tightens slightly. The viewer feels it more than sees it.

**Good at:** natural emphasis; pattern interrupt; low effort

**Weak at:** easy to miss; can blur on 1080p footage

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals retention · effort low

**How:** Scale 105–110% on the clip after the cut, or a quick eased keyframe.

**Backed by:** [Subtle 105–110% punch-in on key phrases](../topics/effects.md#fx-subtle-punch-in), [Bigger 1.15–1.3× punch-ins on punchlines](../topics/effects.md#fx-big-punch-in), [Axial jump cuts every 3–6 words](../topics/editing.md#edit-axial-jump-cuts), [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade) · sources L06, R1

## Big 1.15–1.3× on punchlines
<a id="big"></a>

A smooth, larger push on punchlines and framework names.

**Looks like:** On the punchline the face fills the frame in a smooth push. It's clearly a 'this matters' moment.

**Good at:** strong emphasis; comedy timing; clear 'this matters' signal

**Weak at:** needs 4K for quality; too many feel dizzy

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long · niches all · goals retention · effort low

**How:** Shoot 4K for crop room; eased scale keyframes to 115–130%.

**Backed by:** [Bigger 1.15–1.3× punch-ins on punchlines](../topics/effects.md#fx-big-punch-in), [Subtle 105–110% punch-in on key phrases](../topics/effects.md#fx-subtle-punch-in), [Axial jump cuts every 3–6 words](../topics/editing.md#edit-axial-jump-cuts), [Whip pan over recursive zoom](../topics/transitions.md#l10-whip-not-recursive-zoom) · sources L07

## Axial jump cuts every 3–6 words
<a id="axial-jumps"></a>

Alternate between a medium shot and a digital punch-in on the same angle every few words.

**Looks like:** Medium, close, medium, close, each landing on an emphasis word. A single camera feels like two.

**Good at:** pace from one camera; hides jump cuts; hits emphasis words

**Weak at:** edit time; feels choppy if it's random

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long · niches all · goals retention · effort medium

**How:** Alternate the scale on each jump cut in CapCut/VN.

**Backed by:** [Axial jump cuts every 3–6 words](../topics/editing.md#edit-axial-jump-cuts), [Subtle 105–110% punch-in on key phrases](../topics/effects.md#fx-subtle-punch-in), [Whip pan over recursive zoom](../topics/transitions.md#l10-whip-not-recursive-zoom), [Demo each effect on your own shot](../topics/effects.md#l10-apply-effect-on-yourself) · sources L07

## Push-ins on percussive hits
<a id="beat-pushes"></a>

10–15% push-ins and push-outs synced to the music's hits.

**Looks like:** Every drum hit pumps the frame in or out. It feels like a music video.

**Good at:** energy; teasers; gym edits

**Weak at:** distracting under teaching; needs a clear beat

**Best for:** formats reel30, yt-short · niches gym, gaming · goals reach · effort medium

**How:** Beat markers in CapCut, then a scale keyframe on each.

**Backed by:** [Sell a long video with a hyper-edited teaser](../topics/editing.md#edit-teaser-hyper-edited), [Subtle 105–110% punch-in on key phrases](../topics/effects.md#fx-subtle-punch-in), [Cut on the beat or on motion](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-on-beat-motion), [Khandala pans and push-ins were linear](../topics/effects.md#fx-khandala-linear-moves), [Speed ramps: dead time, beats, top rep](../topics/editing.md#edit-speed-ramps) · sources L08

## Mixing
Subtle punch-ins on sections plus a big one on the main punchline is a common pairing (L06 and L07 differ only in size).

## Rule of thumb
Talking short form: subtle. Punchlines: big. Single-camera long form: axial. Music-driven edits: beat pushes.
